votes.motion: Council Member Kallas moved to APPROVE Ordinance Number 2023-11 - Adopting the Final Tax Rate for Salt Lake County for the purpose of levying taxes within the City of Bluffdale Fire and Police Protection Fund for the Fiscal Year 2023-2024, Council Member Hales seconded the motion

Council Member Kallas moved to APPROVE Ordinance Number 2023-19 - Adopting the Final Tax Rate for Utah County for the purpose oflevying taxes within the City of Bluffdale Fire and Police Protection Fund for the Fiscal Year 2023-2024. Council Member Aston seconded the motion
